skills.name: list_files
skills.description: List files and folders at an explicit path.

skills.name: read_file
skills.description: Read the beginning of a UTF-8 text file at an explicit path.

skills.name: search_files
skills.description: Find file or directory names recursively under an explicit directory.

skills.name: write_file
skills.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file at an explicit path. Set overwrite=true to replace an existing file.

skills.name: make_directory
skills.description: Create a directory and any missing parent directories.

skills.name: move_path
skills.description: Move or rename one file or directory to a new explicit path without overwriting.

skills.name: trash_path
skills.description: Move one explicit file or directory to the desktop Trash for recovery.
